verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB is a managed database service, so an interactive API reference is a fair thing to ask for. The pack has no evidence of one: there is no API explorer, no try-it console, and no runnable reference examples. The llms.txt and markdown docs probes, the MCP tools and the ClickHouse client compatibility are adjacent capabilities and do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
